claim: A window one can see through is a four-walled sill sector through the wall between a room and the street. Counted 2026-11-19 for Gravesend (windows.py, no counter kept, not recounted): 74 windows over E1M4, E1M1, E1M2, E3M1 and E3M2, 768 to 1,024 wide, as deep as the wall (128-256), the sill 0.5-0.6 of a body up and the opening 1.0-1.5 bodies tall, most open, the rest glazed with breakable glass (266 or 263, type 511); E3M1's twelve recesses 1,024 wide, 224-288 deep, sills 2.42-4.35 bodies up. A strict recount (2026-11-26) finds 20 through-windows, mostly 1,024 wide, sill medians 0.42-0.48.
